intro.en: Airports, luggage and accommodation, and telling the story of a trip that went wrong.

texto.en:
By air: **facturar** el equipaje, pass through **el control**, wait at **la puerta de embarque** with **la tarjeta de embarque**; the plane **despega**, **hace escala** and **aterriza**. A flight **sale con retraso** or **se anula**.

Where you sleep: **un hotel**, **un hostal**, **una pensión**, **un camping** with **una tienda de campaña** and **un saco de dormir**. In high season everything **está completo**.

Kinds of trip: **un viaje organizado**, **de negocios**, **de fin de curso**; **un crucero**; **irse de puente**, a long weekend made by joining a holiday to the weekend.

A travel story mixes the tenses: the plan in the pluperfect (**habíamos reservado**), the scene in the imperfect (**llovía**, **estaba** completo), the events in the indefinido (**perdimos** el vuelo, **nos perdimos**).

frases.es: El año pasado mi hermana y yo nos fuimos de puente a Lisboa.
frases.en: Last year my sister and I went to Lisbon for the long weekend.

frases.es: Habíamos reservado el vuelo y un hostal en una agencia de viajes.
frases.en: We had booked the flight and a guesthouse at a travel agency.

frases.es: El avión despegó con tres horas de retraso y tuvimos que pagar exceso de equipaje.
frases.en: The plane took off three hours late and we had to pay for excess baggage.

frases.es: Cuando aterrizamos, llovía muchísimo y una de las maletas no apareció.
frases.en: When we landed, it was pouring with rain and one of the suitcases did not turn up.

frases.es: Además, el hostal estaba completo porque habían anulado nuestra reserva por error.
frases.en: What is more, the guesthouse was full because they had cancelled our booking by mistake.

frases.es: Al final hicimos turismo, nos perdimos varias veces y lo pasamos genial.
frases.en: In the end we went sightseeing, got lost several times and had a great time.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write a review of an organised trip, real or invented: itinerary, guide, hotels, what was best and worst.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Argue aloud for travelling in a group or travelling on your own.
